messages:
Alicia (SRE): quick heads-up — i'm primary for the 1600-2000UTC window but gotta step out for a dentist appt ~45m from now. if pager fires during that gap i need someone to take primary. there’s been a recurring telemetry alert about tail latency on inference-service since 0420UTC. not active incident yet but noisy.
incident-bot: ALERT: High tail latency detected on inference-service (p95 > 800ms) — group: inference-pool — alerts/redwood/INC-4981 — triggered 10m ago
Marco (infra): i can jump to primary for the remaining window. quick Q: do we want to failover to the dedicated pool or try cache/kv flush first?
Alicia (SRE): thanks marco — prefer try quick mitigations first (prefix cache invalidation + reduce batching) to avoid failover churn. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/latency-spike
Priya (eng): customer impact check — any 5xxs? error budget bleed?
Alicia (SRE): no 5xxs in SLO window yet, but token cost spiked and p95 doubled for some customers in region-us-west-2. spike correlates with a model rollout around 0330UTC — could be kv cache working set mismatch.
Ben (platform): i'll be secondary. if you failover, ping me to coordinate rolling through the reserved nodes.
Marco (infra): ok i'll take primary. Alicia, can you run the cache metrics quick and post the top keys? if small set we can invalidate. otherwise i’ll prepare failover steps.
Alicia (SRE): on it. metrics query: `curl -s "http://metrics.internal/api/query?m=kv_cache_top_keys&service=inference-service" | jq .`
Alicia (SRE): top keys look like a handful of long prompts from customer-x and partner-beta — TTLs are short though. letting a controlled invalidate for prefix /customers/x/ now.
incident-bot: NOTE: runbook step initiated by Alicia (SRE): prefix invalidation started — command: `rv-cache invalidate --service inference-service --prefix /customers/x/ --confirm`
Marco (infra): seeing p95 drop from 820ms -> 360ms. nice. continuing to monitor. if it climbs >600ms again i'll swap traffic to dedicated-pool-2.
Priya (eng): thanks. Alicia — please confirm handoff in the oncall tool when you step out (so paging routes to Marco). also add a short blurb about what you tried so he has context.
Alicia (SRE): doing that now: `/handoff set-primary @Marco --until 2227004722 --note "taking dentist break, prefix invalidation done; watch p95 and token cost; may swap to dedicated if >600ms"` :wave:
Marco (infra): got the handoff, i'm now primary for the rest of the window. will escalate to Ben for failover if needed. thanks Alicia, enjoy the dentist :)
Ben (platform): standing by. if we failover i'll coordinate draining and rebalancing: `pgctl failover --group inference-pool --target dedicated-pool-2` (will do rolling, not instant, notify customers channel).
Priya (eng): update for the ticket: INC-4981 — mitigation: prefix invalidation reduced p95 to ~350ms; handoff to Marco; secondary Ben; no customer 5xxs. next steps: monitor for 30m, if reoccurs do scheduled failover.
Alicia (SRE): confirmed handoff complete, leaving in ~5m. if anything comes up DM me but assume Marco primary.
Marco (infra): noted. ping if p95 > 600ms or error rate >0.5% — i'll execute failover plan.
incident-bot: RESOLVE: Alert cleared — p95 below threshold for 15m — auto-resolved.
Priya (eng): thanks team, I'll close the loop on the incident and update the postmortem template if this recurs.
Marco (infra): all good here, coverage confirmed for window.
Alicia (SRE): back online — thanks for covering, appreciated :thumbsup:
